finding_variants.text: Operations director still lacked annual required training topics.
The dirctor did not have the training to cover the training topic: Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction.

The director did not have annual training hours in the required topics of Handling, Storing, and Disposing of Hazardous Materials, Administering Medication, and Preventing and Responding to Emergencies due to Food Allergies, Emergency Preparedness, Preventing and controlling spread of communicable diseases and Building and Physical premises safety.
Director needs to complete emergency preparedness, administering medication, communicable disease, physical premises safety, storing handling and disposal of hazardous materials trainings.
The Director was missing three out of the five required training content courses.
The director does not have the required annual training topics for the last annual training year.
